glosses: Of, from or pertaining to Bengal or the Bengalis.

examples.text: Ethnologue, the web-based publication, estimates that there are around 41 languages in Bangladesh and all of them are living. However, 8 of them are in danger of extinction. These include Khiang, Murong, Bawm, Pangkhua among others. It is ironic to think that a nation that fought for the right to speak a language, the first recorded instance of this in history, is the same nation that internally follows an agenda of Bengali supremacy.

glosses: A person from Bengal or of Bengali descent.
A language spoken in Bangladesh and the states of Assam, Tripura and West Bengal, India.
A village in Nancowry tehsil, Nicobar district, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India.

Rabindranâth Tagore, le grand poète bengalî, ami de Tolstoï et de Romain Rolland, dont la Gîtânjalî ou « Offrande lyrique » lui valut de recevoir le prix Nobel de littérature en 1913, fut largement influencé par la pensée de Râmakrishna, chantant la nature et montrant que la Divinité est en fin de compte la plus grande amie de l’homme, à condition toutefois que celui-ci La reconnaisse pour telle.
